_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 05: 2024-11-23 to 2024-12-10. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are right on the cusp of an authentic move of the Spirit in these last days, with harvesters being brought forth and certain investments involved.
mentions.quote: we're right on the cusp right there we're right there ready for this move
mentions.falsify_match: A revival movement of recognised scale begins.

mentions.claim_text: Daily prayer over his wife and children that their eyes be flooded with light and that they go from glory to glory rather than repeat yesterday.
mentions.quote: our eyes are flooded with light father we're hungry for more of you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: family intercession, no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He notes he has not given his usual word laying out how 2025 will pan out, saying only that this is a time like never before to expect God to do something big.
mentions.quote: for 2025 of this is what's going to pan it out
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an explicit statement that no 2025 word has been given yet.

mentions.claim_text: He warns that anyone not in the right place at the right time, hearing God daily, may have the opportunity to go home early, and promises divine protection and specific guidance to those who listen.
mentions.quote: if you're not in the right place at the right time hearing him
mentions.condition_text: protection conditioned on hearing and obeying him daily
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a death is attributable to not having listened.

mentions.claim_text: He says a lot of babies are coming in 2025 and points to viewers being baptised in the Spirit, healed and set free through the channel.
mentions.quote: babies are coming in 2025 folks a lot of babies
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable at corpus level: births among an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: Praying over England, Ireland and Italy, he asks that if the volcano he saw near Rome goes off the people would be awake and get out of harm's way, adding that he saw it go off but believes they may have changed things.
mentions.quote: the volcano that I saw in Italy down by Rome
mentions.condition_text: he says outright that prayer may have changed the outcome he saw
mentions.falsify_match: A significant eruption in the Campi Flegrei or Vesuvius area near Rome.
mentions.falsify_miss: No eruption, which he has pre-attributed to intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2025 will be an amazing year on the channel with a lot shown to them, and that accuracy in the prophetic will be one of those things because accuracy builds trust.
mentions.quote: accuracy in the prophetic will be one of them being accurate
mentions.falsify_match: His 2025 predictions land at a rate better than chance.

mentions.claim_text: A word given in the first person: days of great favour beyond comprehension are coming, a kingly anointing flowing supernaturally through the hearer as long as they stay in step with him day to day.
mentions.quote: there will be days of great favor great days of great favor
mentions.condition_text: the flow is conditioned on staying in step with him daily
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the staying-in-step clause makes any absence of favour the hearer's.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord told him that by the Super Bowl, three weeks after Trump is sworn in, there would be an even greater acceleration of things and of finances.
mentions.quote: when you get to the Super Bowl there'll be even more of an acceleration
mentions.falsify_match: A marked financial acceleration in the US around 9 February 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such acceleration by that date.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that demonic spirits attempting havoc before 20 January are bound, naming Harris and the deep state, and that no plot to divide or bring down the nation succeeds.
mentions.quote: any kind of demonic spirits to try to maneuver to try to cause any havoc
mentions.condition_text: explicitly praying the plot down before the inauguration
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt to prevent or disrupt the January 2025 transfer of power.
mentions.falsify_miss: The transfer proceeds normally, which he would credit to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord keeps speaking to him about 2025 as a time to draw close, and that it is not a year to be lukewarm but to be hot or cold.
mentions.quote: 2025 it's not a time to be lukewarm
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation about spiritual temperature.

mentions.claim_text: He places a great drought and a great plague in 2026, likely the summer, at the midterm of Trump's presidency, and recalls seeing Trump on a platform addressing the American people to warn of a very deadly plague coming.
mentions.quote: summer of 2026 is when he believes that we will see a great drought
mentions.time_phrase: summer of 2026, midterm of the presidency
mentions.falsify_match: A severe US drought and a deadly outbreak in 2026, with Trump addressing the nation about it.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major season of war with Russia is still to come in 2025 but that he is praying against it, and repeats the Lord's word of an extended four years as a window for revival and an outpouring of finances.
mentions.quote: enter into a major season of war in 2025
mentions.condition_text: he states he is praying against the war and for peace
mentions.falsify_match: A major escalation to war involving Russia during 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such escalation, which he would attribute to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says the measures and balances in heaven shifted because the saints prayed and cried out in October, giving a window of opportunity, and asks what will be done with the next four years.
mentions.quote: the Saints prayed and cried out in October gave us a window
mentions.condition_text: the whole window is attributed to October intercession
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a granted window cannot be distinguished from ordinary time.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him and his family to take 10,000 IU of vitamin D3 with K2 daily from around October through the winter months, flagging it as what they do rather than health advice.
mentions.quote: the Lord told Diana and me and the children to take
mentions.falsify_match: Part of the standing preparedness instruction set, not a prediction. Recorded for completeness.

mentions.claim_text: He says by the Spirit that another wave of something is coming but he does not yet know when, believes they will try it in 2026 or 2027 because it has been pushed down the road, and declines to quote dates.
mentions.quote: there's another wave coming of something I do not know when yet
mentions.falsify_match: A second pandemic wave or comparable health emergency in 2026 or 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He says the crypto space becomes a civilised society rather than the wild west, with things set in motion to make it stable and stability beyond comprehension into 2025 and 2026, and that he saw five main pillars of differing strength.
mentions.quote: I saw five five I saw five main pillars
mentions.falsify_match: Crypto regulation stabilises the sector by end of 2026, with five dominant assets or frameworks identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: The sector stays unregulated and volatile.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that prayer without scripture behind it gets no results, illustrated with an account of a preacher praying for someone's marriage to break up.
mentions.quote: you have to have scripture back prayer if you want results
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching on prayer method.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for Trump and his family through the rest of December and part of January until he is sworn in, that no weapon formed against them prospers.
mentions.quote: we just have the rest of December and part of January to go to pray
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt on Trump or his family before the inauguration.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, which he would attribute to the prayer cover.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is raising up new Davids in leadership, that a great revival is coming and they will soar, and tells viewers to believe for big going from 2024 into 2025 while acknowledging dark things too.
mentions.quote: we will see a great great Revival and we will soar
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival and new figures rising in leadership during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told viewers a year earlier that Trump's trials would run to late summer 2024 as a distraction, and that what was planned for harm actually saved his life because it kept him off the campaign trail.
mentions.quote: he would have trials go clear up until late summer of 2024
mentions.falsify_match: A fulfilment assertion on trump-indictments-summer, checkable against the actual 2024 trial calendar.
mentions.falsify_miss: The trials did not run to late summer, or the protective reading does not hold.

mentions.claim_text: In tongues and declaration he calls in the October outpouring, saying the wave will hit with ferocity and impact and the church will take on Jesus.
mentions.quote: call the October outpouring we will see it we will see it
mentions.falsify_match: A revival wave beginning in an October and widely recognised.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such wave, though the year is unspecified.

mentions.claim_text: Thanksgiving teaching on the variety of creation, that God could have made one bird or one flower but made all kinds richly for us to enjoy.
mentions.quote: he made all kinds of things for us richly to enjoy
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, no claim.

mentions.claim_text: Encouragement that partial progress counts even without the full manifestation of what you have believed for, using Noah releasing the dove.
mentions.quote: I may not have my full manifestation of what I've been believing for
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation, and a template for accepting partial fulfilment.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers 2024 will be the best year they have lived so far and that the year is not over, urging joy rather than sadness.
mentions.quote: this will be the best year you've ever lived so far 2024
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal best year with no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He was told to pray that Trump has supernatural wisdom in leading the country and that on 20 January there will be a supernatural turnaround in all kinds of things because God's people prayed and turned from their wicked ways.
mentions.quote: on January the 20th that we will have a supernatural turnaround
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on the people praying and turning from wickedness
mentions.falsify_match: A visible national turnaround dated to the January 2025 inauguration.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for grace and an extended four years until 2028, and says that against those who claim otherwise Jesus is coming soon and believers should occupy until he comes.
mentions.quote: an extended years four years father of 20 until 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The four-year window runs to 2028 without the judgments arriving.

mentions.claim_text: He declares 2025 a great year for viewers, standing on covenant rather than on what is seen or felt.
mentions.quote: 2025 will be a great year in jesus' name
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal outcome, no external criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer to finish 2024 strong, healed and prosperous, calling those things that be not as though they were.
mentions.quote: we're going to live long and finish strong
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a run of headlines about UFOs, government knowledge, large non-human creatures and an alien invasion underway, saying the subject will be talked about constantly in the media until it becomes the norm.
mentions.quote: it's going to start to become like I almost to say the norm
mentions.falsify_match: Continued mainstreaming of UAP coverage in major media.

mentions.claim_text: An altar call warning that tomorrow is not guaranteed, with the Lord asking him whether he comprehends eternity and telling him to count the stars as years.
mentions.quote: do you have a comprehension of Eternity Brandon
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: altar call.

mentions.claim_text: Rather than speak negatively about what he sees, he prays in tongues over it for ten minutes so that a perfect prayer comes out instead of his own words, believing for a turn of events in the spirit.
mentions.quote: I want to speak faith into it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: his stated method for handling a warning he does not want to voice.

mentions.claim_text: After a dream he warns viewers to be on guard in public places, naming the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, Rockin' New Year's Eve, Atlanta and shopping areas as places to pray over.
mentions.quote: big events in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade praying over that next week
mentions.condition_text: given as prayer targets rather than fixed events
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a named US mass gathering between late November 2024 and New Year.

mentions.claim_text: He describes asking the Lord for the direction of 2025 and whether there will be a major crash and the house of cards falling, while praying over the plague and the economy he has been shown.
mentions.quote: a major crash for 2025 are we going to see the house of cards fall
mentions.falsify_match: A question he asks rather than a claim he makes. Recorded because it dates his uncertainty about the 2025 crash.

mentions.claim_text: He prays a hedge of protection over the vice president and the nation for the 59 days remaining to the inauguration, and that Biden will be out of power.
mentions.quote: over the next 50 some days I believe it's 59 days
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt to disrupt the transfer during those 59 days.

mentions.claim_text: Reacting to another ministry scandal, he says the Lord told him around November of the previous year that scandals in ministries were coming.
mentions.quote: I warned you while this was coming I told you back
mentions.falsify_match: A run of publicised scandals among prominent ministries.
mentions.falsify_miss: No unusual run of ministry scandals.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts working for large ministries and seeing prominent ministers lose their tempers with staff, as context for why scandals surface.
mentions.quote: I worked for some of these big ministers
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal recollection.

mentions.claim_text: He says plainly that he misses timing quite a bit because he assumes what the Spirit is saying and how quickly it will come, and that he does not always have everything right.
mentions.quote: I miss timing quite a bit because I'm assuming what he's saying
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and one of the franker statements of it: the error is located in his assumption, not in the word.

mentions.claim_text: Applying first the blade, then the ear, then the full manifestation to an investment, he says the full manifestation comes at ten thousand dollars for something starting with an X and containing a p, and calls it profoundly worth investing in.
mentions.quote: with $10,000 per XP what you want to call it
mentions.falsify_match: XRP trades at or above $10,000.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, though no date is given.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that angels cause all hidden things to be revealed and every plot of the wicked be destroyed, adding that you do not always see everything the Lord tells you is coming.
mentions.quote: cause all hidden things to be revealed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and explicitly so: he states you may never see the thing prayed against.
